intro.h2: Tile installation in Billings, MT, from the prep up
paragraphs: Fisher Tile & Remodeling LLC does tile installation in Billings, MT, for homes and businesses. Jake is the tile setter our customers know by name. The photos on our Google profile show the kind of work we like best: a marble basketweave shower floor around a bronze drain, and a polished herringbone backsplash finished with a marble pencil edge.

Good tile starts behind the tile. One business owner was away while we tiled his commercial showers, so Jake decided what prep work needed doing and did it, and he says he would trust us and hire us again. A homeowner says Jake finished in the time frame he gave and cleaned up his work space every day.

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: Showers are where tile has to work hardest, so we take the layers under it seriously. This shower floor is white marble basketweave with small black inserts, cut neatly around a decorative bronze drain. Walls, floors, niches and trim can all be planned to match.

image.alt: Close view of a marble basketweave shower floor with black accent squares around a bronze drain grate

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: A backsplash is small, but every cut shows. In this kitchen we ran marble herringbone mosaic from the counter to the cabinets, finished the open end with a marble pencil trim and kept the pattern lined up around outlets and a window sill.

image.alt: Marble herringbone mosaic backsplash with a marble pencil trim edge above a white quartz counter and undermount sink

items.name: Commercial showers
items.blurb: We tile for businesses too. One owner hired us for his commercial showers and was away during the work, so Jake handled the decisions on prep behind the tile himself. The owner calls us honest and fair and says he would definitely hire us again.

process.h2: How a tile job with Fisher Tile works

steps.title: Call Jake
steps.text: Call (406) 860-2257 between 8 AM and 5 PM on a weekday and tell us about the shower, backsplash or commercial space.

steps.title: Plan the tile
steps.text: We talk through tile, pattern and trim, and give you a time frame for the job before the first tile is set.

steps.title: Prep behind the tile
steps.text: The surfaces behind the tile get prepped first, because that hidden work decides how long the finished tile holds up.

steps.title: Set and clean daily
steps.text: Jake sets the tile on schedule and cleans the work space at the end of every day while the job is underway.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We look over the finished tile with you, checking cuts, grout lines and trim edges so you are happy with every corner.

service_area.h2: Tile installation in Billings, MT and nearby
service_area.text: Fisher Tile & Remodeling LLC works out of 115 Foster Ln in Billings, MT, and takes on tile jobs for homes and businesses in the Billings area. If you are outside town and want a shower, backsplash or commercial tile job done, call (406) 860-2257 and tell us where the project is. We will let you know whether we can take it on.

items.a: No. Showers are a big part of our work, but we also install kitchen backsplashes and tile commercial showers for business owners. The photos on our Google profile include a marble basketweave shower floor and a herringbone marble backsplash with pencil trim. Call to talk about your project.

items.q: Why does the prep behind the tile matter?
items.a: The tile you see is only the top layer. What sits behind it decides whether a shower stays sound over the years. On one commercial job the owner was away, so Jake made the calls on what prep was needed before tiling, and the owner says he would trust us again.

items.q: Will you stick to the schedule?
items.a: We give you a time frame before we start and work to it. One homeowner says Jake completed her job in the time frame he gave her, and timeliness is one of the most common topics in our Google reviews. If anything changes along the way, we tell you.

items.q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
items.a: Yes. Along with homes, we tile for businesses. One business owner had us tile his commercial showers and describes us as honest, fair and a pleasure to work with. Call (406) 860-2257 to tell us about your space and timeline.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday. Our address is 115 Foster Ln, Billings, MT 59101. Calling (406) 860-2257 during those hours is the fastest way to reach Jake about a new tile project.

final_cta.text: Call Jake at Fisher Tile & Remodeling to talk through your shower or backsplash.
